title: Unit Event — Live with Memories — Episode4 The Courage to Face It

meta.Episode: Episode4 — The Courage to Face It
meta.Event Outline: The wind is in Leo/need's sails as the band continues performing and starts to build its own fanbase. But then, they encounter a brother and sister, who are Leo/need fans, having an argument.

rows.Line: Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, you girls...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I can't believe you actually jumped in to save her. You really had us startled...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
S-Sorry about that.
I wasn't really thinking...

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line:
L-Leo/need...?!
What are you all doing here...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
We just happened to see you here.
But Ichi bolted before the rest of us could do anything!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, that was a big surprise...
Thank goodness you're both okay.

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line:
I had no idea...
U-Um... Thank you all very much for looking out for me!

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line:
Also, Hoshino...
I'm sorry about running into you the other day.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line:
...!
I-I'm so sorry!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
You knew it was me?
Um... Your name's Hanano, right?

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line: What? How do you know my name...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We actually had a chance to talk to your brother after our show the other day. That was when he told us.

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line: My brother...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And... It isn't safe for you to be out here all alone since it's already getting dark.

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line:
Right...
But I... Um...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (She doesn't want to go home...)

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line: Um... Did my brother tell you anything?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Huh? Oh...
Well, just a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So we sort of understand why you don't want to go home immediately.

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line: So... What did he tell you?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line: He messaged me earlier, but I haven't read it yet since he's probably worried sick and really angry at me...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, he isn't mad!
He's just that worried about you!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah.
It's clear that you mean the world to him, Hanano.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: He even claimed that he's the one making you suffer because of what he said.

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line: He... He really is a big dummy...

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line:
It's not his fault...
I've never blamed him for this... Not once...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hanano...

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line: I... I was able to learn about Leo/need because he was nice enough to take me to that live house.

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line: When our parents had decided to get divorced, he thought a show at that live house would serve as a nice distraction for us...

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line: After I told him that I thought your music's really amazing, he's gone out of his way to go with me every time...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line: And about my family... Yota isn't the reason I can't get to know them better...

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line: I'm scared... No, I'm terrified that we won't get to see each other if I start calling them “family”...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Here, use my handkerchief...

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line:
*Sob*
I'm sorry... I promise to give it back after washing it...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
Just let it all out.

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line: I know what he was trying to say...

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line: He was just doing what he thought was best for me by asking to not meet him anymore...

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line: I know that but... It hurts so much...

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line: But... But...

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line: I guess we don't get to be together forever just because we're siblings...

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line: We have to go our separate ways at some point... And for us, that time might be now...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Hanano clearly understands what her brother said and is actually thinking about not seeing him...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (That may be necessary based on their current situation... But...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Is this really what's best...?)

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line: I'm sorry for bursting into tears like that... But I feel much better after telling all of you about what's going on with us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Are you really gonna be okay...?

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line:
Yes.
I... From now on, I promise to go straight home. I'm causing Yota enough trouble as it is.

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line: I'm sorry for causing you all so much trouble too. Again, thank you for what you did.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line:
My brother won't be coming anymore, but...
I'll be back to see more of your shows!

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line: Now... If you'll excuse me...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: W-Wait...!!

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Would you mind asking your brother to go see one last show with you...?

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line: What? Ask my brother...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. We're doing another show in two weeks...! We'd really like it if you two could come together to see us one last time.

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line:
Thank you very much...
But why...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Huh?
Why? Because...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We want to give you two a show as a present! Right, Ichi?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's right. We're so happy that you've become our fans that we want to give you a show as a small token of our appreciation if you really won't be able to come together to see us anymore...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: After all, we were able to play so well because we knew you were there to hear us play.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Exactly. We promise to give you the best show we've ever done, so we hope you'll come see it.

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line:
Okay...
I can't guarantee that Yota will agree to meet me, but I'll try asking him...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line:
No, I should be the one thanking you.
Anyway, bye...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thank you all so much...
I wasn't really sure what to say after inviting her to come see our show...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe!
We knew what to say because we all feel the same way!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah.
In the end, I just couldn't let this be.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Me too...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
They mean so much to each other...
Having to part ways like this must be absolutely unbearable for them...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But we're gonna do what we can so they don't have to feel that way, right...?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What we can...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Um, I know we don't have much time...
But mind if I try writing a song...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I know one song probably won't do much...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I want to do everything in my power to relieve them of their pain.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'll need help writing the music for it since I'm still learning, but I promise to write some good lyrics for it...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I like it. This idea's very you, Ichika.
However, we're doing this right if we're actually going through with it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: R-Right!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, Ichi!
Wanna try coming up with the music together? I really feel like helping those two get through this!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay...!
Thanks, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: In that case, I'll try coming up with a schedule for us.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks, all of you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Let's make our next show a really good one...!
